name: Slide In Menu
description: Fixed top bar with brand and a Menu button that opens a right-side layered slide-in panel with large uppercase links, numbering, social links and a dimmed overlay.
contents: Fixed header with brand name, star icon and menu toggle button
Slide-in panel with three stacked color layers, numbered links and social links
behavior: GSAP timeline slides panel layers in with staggered link and social reveals
Menu label swaps to Close and the plus icon rotates
Link hover slides text up and fills the row
Overlay click, link click or Escape closes the menu
editableByProps: Brand, labels, menu and social links
Colors of text, panel layers, hover fill and overlay
Panel width, padding, radius and animation duration

needsCodeEdit.change: Slide the panel from the left

fixed: Header is fixed to the top of the viewport and the menu panel is fixed full screen above page content
